question: Which process maintains the predominant extracellular and intracellular cation distributions?
cited_learning_objective: Define composition of body fluids and sodium and potassium distribution in fluid compartments. options.rationale: Na+/K+ ATPase establishes the opposing sodium and potassium gradients that support high extracellular Na+ and high intracellular K+.
NHE3 mediates proximal tubular Na+ entry in exchange for H+. It would be correct for proximal sodium reabsorption rather than systemic cation distribution.
NCC reabsorbs NaCl in the distal tubule. It would be correct if the question concerned the target of thiazide diuretics.
NKCC2 reabsorbs Na+, K+, and Cl- in the thick ascending limb. It would be correct for the principal target of loop diuretics.
